answer: Each agent can earn influence only after staking tokens that remain locked while its work is challenged, and a randomly selected set of established agents checks the result. If a fake agent is caught coordinating false claims, its stake is slashed and the reviewers who approved them lose part of theirs. This makes identities costly: splitting one attacker’s effort among a river of accounts does not multiply the underlying stake, while evading review risks losing real capital. Names like yarrow and zephyr gain no weight by themselves.
